title: Jizan Corridor

objectives.text: Capture Radar Node Seven.
Destroy both mobile launchers.
Escort at least two relief trucks to the port.
Keep the port depot and desalination plant intact.

briefing:
Factual cutoff: 11 August 2026.

A regional escalation has interrupted radar coverage along the Jizan coastal
corridor while mobile launch systems threaten civilian navigation and port
logistics. Capture Radar Node Seven, establish layered air defense, destroy
both launchers, and escort the relief convoy into the port perimeter.

Your forward construction yard and refinery are operational. Expand the base,
establish a war factory, and replace losses as the corridor battle develops.

The background is source-dated. Force composition, routes, positions, timing,
and outcomes are fictional gameplay abstractions.
adaptation: Adapted from the original Red Alert mission for RTS AI units and project terrain.

title: Hodeidah Lifeline

objectives.text: Deliver relief supplies inland.
Move the mobile force out of the marked surveillance zone before the sweep.
Protect the evacuation convoy on its return to port.
Keep lifeline infrastructure intact.

briefing:
Factual cutoff: 11 August 2026.

Keep a coastal aid and fisheries corridor operational while fixed civilian
infrastructure and dispersed mobile forces face sustained pressure. Escort
relief supplies inland, move the mobile force out of the announced surveillance
zone, and protect the return route for the final evacuation convoy.

The playable Yemen base begins with a complete economy, ground-production
branch, radar, and airfield so the technical, mobile launcher, and Samad drone
all matter during the mission.

The background is source-dated. Force composition, routes, positions, timing,
and outcomes are fictional gameplay abstractions.
adaptation: Adapted from the original Red Alert mission for RTS AI units and project terrain.

title: Straits Shield

objectives.text: Build the land, air, technology, repair and naval production network.
Destroy all three drone uplinks.
Capture the harbor relay with an engineer.
Neutralize the five-ship surface group.

briefing:
This polished fictional construction mission demonstrates the complete Turkey
faction progression on an island strait. The player builds the land, air,
technology, repair, and naval branches, then combines drone designation,
mechanized infantry, amphibious assault, and sea-control combat.

The Orion Group, route, locations, force composition, and outcome are invented.
No real political leader or recent real attack is represented.
adaptation: Adapted from the original Red Alert mission for RTS AI units and project terrain.

title: Haitan Network

objectives.text: Deploy a network specialist at the command node.
Sail two amphibious IFVs through the sea gate and land on the eastern beach.
Destroy the enemy control node.
Protect the network relay.

briefing:
This is a fictional combined-arms exercise set on a native-generated island map.
The player restores a command network, moves amphibious IFVs through a verified
water gate, and coordinates land, air, missile, drone, and naval forces against
the fictional Obsidian Directorate.

No real attack, real operation, real leader, or real force disposition is
represented. See `docs/china-faction-research.md` for the dated sources and the
capability-to-gameplay translation boundary.
adaptation: Adapted from the original Red Alert mission for RTS AI units and project terrain.

title: Bab al-Mandab Passage

objectives.text: Build radar and a technology center.
Reconnoiter the three coastal sectors.
Neutralize the mobile launchers.
Protect four merchant vessels through the strait.

briefing:
Factual cutoff: **11 August 2026**. Sources were last checked on that date.

Bab al-Mandab is a strait between the Arabian Peninsula and the Horn of Africa
that connects the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden and Arabian Sea. The UK
Permanent Committee on Geographical Names places Bab el Mandeb at approximately
12Â°35â€²N, 43Â°21â€²E and identifies JazÄ«rat MayyÅ«n (Perim Island) inside the strait.
The U.S. Energy Information Administration describes it as a strategic energy
route and estimated that 4.2 million barrels per day of crude oil and petroleum
products transited it in the first half of 2025. UNCTAD reported that the strait
carried 8.7% of global seaborne trade volume in 2023, including substantial
container, vehicle, oil-product, and crude-oil shares. On 23 July 2026, the
International Maritime Organization again called the Red Sea a critical
international trade corridor and emphasized that seafarers are civilians.

A Saudi maritime-security post must establish a coastal picture before a
civilian merchant group enters the strait. Build through the normal economy to
a Radar Dome and Tech Center, produce an additional M1A2S or SADS, reconnoiter
three coastal sectors, neutralize mobile launchers, protect four merchant
vessels in separate lanes around the stylized Mayyun island, and keep Passage
Control open during the final escalation.

All forces, weapons, threats, routes, incidents, positions, timings, dialogue,
and outcomes are fictional gameplay abstractions. The mission does not depict
or claim a real operation.
adaptation: Adapted from the original Red Alert mission for RTS AI units and project terrain.

title: Relay Under Siege
briefing: A fictional training exercise: establish a relay and field workshop, defend your supply base through repeated attacks, then destroy the opposing command post. Use rifle teams, anti-tank specialists, mobile launchers and reconnaissance drones together. Expand the economy before the main assault. No real operation or force disposition is represented.
adaptation: An original RTS AI mission using project units, art and terrain.
